intent: Within one source/recruitment study, estimate species-specific seasonal night/day GPS displacement shifts at matched astronomical photoperiod. This is a hypothesis-led ecological pattern, not a prediction benchmark.
selection: From complete fixed 437-package Movebank collection; chosen before viewing ANY Utah taxon movement outcomes. Utah UDWR 2019–2020 multi-taxon source includes pronghorn, elk, mule deer and bighorn sheep. All four must be retained regardless of eligibility, effect sign or null results.

source.original_file: GPS tracking of ungulates in Utah by UDWR (2019-2020).csv.zip

observation.taxon_key: original individual-taxon-canonical-name, exact scientific-name match to all four frozen original archive taxon labels
observation.animal_key: (taxon, original individual-local-identifier); preserve identity only inside runner, no export
observation.fix_selection: Within (taxon, individual, UTC clock hour), select the actual source GPS fix nearest the START of that hour using timestamp only; preserve no interpolated points and do not choose by position or GPS displacement.
observation.primary_rule: Apply frozen Northern June-solstice v0 analysis unchanged after clock-time-only selection: actual consecutive steps 0.5 to 2 hours, start/midpoint/end same solar date and day/night, step <=60 km/h, >=3 day AND night accepted steps per date, <=5 min solar daylength mismatches on increasing/decreasing branches, >=30 days between matched dates, one-to-one no date reuse, per-daypart seasonal step count ratio within 0.5..2, >=10 date pairs per individual-year.
observation.primary_effect: falling-minus-rising branch difference of [log1p(median night GPS step km/h) - log1p(median day GPS step km/h)]; mean equally across matched date pairs, annual cycles within individual, then equal individuals per taxon
observation.report: For EACH of four species: source rows and animals, hourly selected fixes, movement-supported individuals, paired-year counts, paired-day comparisons, difference and daytime/nighttime components, #positive and #negative animals, fixed seed 2000-cluster-bootstrap percentile interval if >=5 individuals; null/undefined retained.
observation.no_raw: Do not export GPS coordinates, exact dates, individual identifiers, original archive observations or animal-level effects.

interpretation.scope: Four taxa sampled under one public original source study reduces heterogeneity between source archives, but species may be tracked in non-overlapping sites/years with different devices, and equal fix criteria do not guarantee equal effort. Population identification and co-location require separate work.
interpretation.population_generalization: A single source archive is not multiple independent ecosystems. Animals within each species may be spatially/temporally clustered; do not treat N fixes as independent ecological replicates.
interpretation.alt_explanations: calendar phase, thermal environment, rainfall/vegetation, reproductive state, migration and anthropogenic activity. None are causally isolated in this first comparison.
interpretation.links: Previous independent source results: Banff wapiti +0.04500, Wyoming Sublette mule deer +0.03115; these are context, not hypotheses to tune or mandatory positive outcomes.

failure_policy: Source MD5/checksum mismatch, missing observation coverage or insufficient individuals remain HOLD or UNAVAILABLE with all original taxon labels preserved. No thresholds adjusted after outcomes.
